fullDescription: A high-density dark-mode wizard interface designed for complex SaaS, fintech, or data analysis applications. It features an orange-accented palette, inter-based editorial typography with heavy letter-spacing on headers, and a dual-column layout for metric selection. The aesthetic is professional and utilitarian, utilizing subtle hover states, compact checkboxes, and a distinct primary/secondary information hierarchy. Suitable for forecasting tools, dashboard configuration screens, and multi-step technical setups.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated dark-themed wizard interface (840x720px) using the Inter font family, featuring an orange primary accent (#e37400). The layout uses a fixed sidebar for navigation and a two-column main content area for density, with specific focus on compact data rows and tabular numeric inputs.

## Estilo Visual
Create a UI with a dark-mode theme. Background: #151517; Surface: #212121; Borders: #424242. Primary Accent: #e37400 (Orange). Typography: 'Inter', sans-serif. Use 'font-size: 0.625rem' with 'font-weight: 700' and 'letter-spacing: 0.1em' for section headers. Body text: 0.75rem (sm) or 0.875rem (base). Interactive elements should have a 300ms transition. Checkboxes: 14px size, rounded corners, bg-gray-800, orange-900 check fill. Primary badges: 8px font-size, bold, 6px horizontal padding, 2px vertical padding, rounded-sm.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Progress Bar
Implement a full-width 3px high progress bar at the very top of the dialog. Background: #424242; Fill: #e37400. The fill width should transition smoothly.

### Sidebar Navigation
A 240px sidebar with 16px padding (px-3 py-4). Items are vertical buttons with a gap of 2px. Each item has a 24px circular indicator. States: Completed (Green-600 with check icon), Active (Orange-900 with white number), Pending (Gray-800 with gray-500 number). Text is 13px, font-medium.

### Content Header
Margin-bottom of 20px. Title: 14px (base), bold, white (#F5F5F5). Subtitle: 12px (sm), gray-400 (#9E9E9E).

### Info Callout
A compact notification box with 10px padding (px-3.5 py-2.5). Border: #2e79e2 (blue-800) at 40% opacity. Background: blue-950 at 20% opacity. Text: 10px blue-400.

### Metrics Grid
A 2-column layout (grid-cols-2) with a 48px gap (gap-x-12). Each column has an uppercase label header (10px, tracking-widest, gray-500) and a description (10px, gray-600). Metrics are listed in compact rows.

### Parameter Section
A standalone card at the bottom of the content area. Background: #151517; Border: #424242; Padding: 20px (p-5). Header: 10px uppercase bold. Inputs: 96px width, bg-gray-800, 12px text, tabular-nums.

### Footer Actions
Fixed height footer with 24px horizontal padding. Border-top: #424242. Left side: Back, Cancel, and Skip buttons (10px bold uppercase, tracking-wider). Right side: Continue button (bg-orange-900, white text, 10px bold uppercase).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Interactive Metric Row — A checkbox row that toggles selection and primary status.
Layout: Flex row, items-center, gap 10px. Padding: 6px vertical, 8px horizontal. Hover state: bg-gray-800 at 40% opacity. Selected state: bg-orange-900 at 5% or 10% opacity. Elements: 14px checkbox, 12px font-medium label, 10px gray-500 secondary label. Right-aligned 'SET PRIMARY' or 'PRIMARY' badge. 'SET PRIMARY' badge: bg-gray-800, text-gray-500, hover:text-gray-300, 8px font-size, bold.

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Use 'tabular-nums' for all numeric inputs to ensure alignment. MUST: Use 'tracking-widest' (0.1em) for all 10px uppercase labels. DO NOT: Use standard 16px body text; the maximum base text size is 14px to maintain data density. DO NOT: Use rounded corners larger than 8px for the main dialog or 4px for internal components.

style.description: The design system uses a strictly dark palette (Black-900: #151517, Gray-900: #212121) with a high-contrast orange primary color (#e37400). Typography relies on Inter, using font sizes ranging from 10px (xs) to 21px (xl). It emphasizes data density through 'uppercase tracking-widest' labels (10px, bold) and compact 1.5-unit vertical padding on list items. Micro-interactions include 300ms transitions on progress bars and subtle background shifts (hover:bg-gray-800/40) for row selection.
